en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a view of a fortified complex. On the left is a multi‑storey building with several chimneys and shuttered windows, partly obscured by vegetation. In the center is a tree and a dirt path leading between stone walls. On the right stands a round stone tower with a conical roof, part of the fortification. Printed German text in red appears in the upper right and along the bottom edge.
